info.title: ce
info.description: Ultra-fast code graph exploration & architecture mapping CLI and MCP server

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize a .codeexplorer workspace in the current or specified directory.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Target directory to initialize (defaults to current working directory).

options.name: --force
options.description: Reinitialize workspace and overwrite existing database if already present. [default: False]

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Workspace name (defaults to current folder name).

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Scan and index a directory into the nearest workspace.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear previous data for this path before scanning. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to scan and index (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: index
commands.description: Alias for 'scan': index a directory into the nearest workspace.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Clear previous data for this path before scanning. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to scan and index (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show status and summary of the nearest workspace.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output status in JSON format. [default: False]

commands.name: info
commands.description: Alias for 'status': show summary of the nearest workspace.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output status in JSON format. [default: False]

commands.name: clear
commands.description: Clear indexed data from the nearest workspace database.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt when clearing. [default: False]

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Specific sub-path to clear from the graph. If omitted, clears entire database.

commands.name: queries
commands.description: Lists all available built-in and workspace custom queries.

options.name: --query
options.description: The Cypher query string to execute (alternative to positional argument).

options.name: --file
options.description: Path to a .cypher file to execute.

options.name: --name
options.description: Name of a built-in or custom query to execute.

options.name: --list
options.description: List all available built-in and workspace custom queries.

options.name: --show
options.description: Display the Cypher source code of a built-in or custom query by name.

options.name: --db-path
options.description: Explicit SQLite database path (defaults to nearest .codeexplorer/graph.db).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Starting directory to look for workspace (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --json
options.description: Output results as formatted JSON (alias for --format json).

options.name: --no-truncate
options.description: Do not truncate long text values in table columns.

options.name: --param
options.description: Key-value parameter to pass to the Cypher query (e.g. -p tableName=users). Can be repeated.

arguments.name: CYPHER
arguments.description: The Cypher query string to execute.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Starts the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the nearest workspace (stdio by default).

options.name: --db-path
options.description: Explicit SQLite database path (defaults to nearest .codeexplorer/graph.db).

options.name: --port
options.description: HTTP port to run as an SSE network service (0 for stdio). [default: 0]

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Recursively parses a directory and loads structural nodes into the SQLite graph database.

options.name: --dir
options.description: The codebase directory to scan and parse.

options.name: --clear
options.description: Whether to surgically clear only this workspace's previous data before ingestion.

options.name: --clear-all
options.description: Whether to perform a global database clear of all workspaces before ingestion.

commands.name: export
commands.description: Export architecture and system topology diagrams in Mermaid or C4 format.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file path (prints to stdout if omitted).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Starts the real-time WebSocket and HTTP API server for CodeExplorer.

options.name: --port
options.description: Port to listen on (0 for automatically allocated ephemeral port). [default: 0]

options.name: --idle-timeout
options.description: Seconds of inactivity with 0 connected clients before automatic shutdown (0 to disable). [default: 30]

commands.name: view
commands.description: View architectural projections (C1 system context, C2 service flow, C3 component, domain map, tiered).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: dependencies
commands.description: Inspect project dependencies with runtime vs build filtering.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: contracts
commands.description: List ingress and egress service communication contracts (HTTP endpoints, gRPC calls, message publishers/subscribers).

options.name: --service
options.description: Name of the service or project.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Trace cross-service execution flow from an entry point or service.

options.name: --entry
options.description: Optional entry point or endpoint URL.

options.name: --dir
options.description: Path to workspace directory (defaults to current directory).
